title: Lipid Analysis Assay by GC-Mass Spectrometry
author: Henri Brunengraber
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yehftb6
materials: Homogenize on ice with polytron homogenizer (tissue only)
Cover and heat for 3 hours at 85ºC

steps.title: Add KOH ethanol solution
steps.instruction: Pipette 1 mL of 1 N KOH in 70 % ethanol for each 100 mg of tissue or 100 µL of plasma into a glass screw‑top tube (less tissue/plasma may be used).

steps.title: Spike internal standards
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of 1 mg · mL⁻¹ heptadecanoic acid (C17:0) and cholesterol‑d₇ to the tube for every 100 µL of tissue; adjust the amount of standards after testing a representative sample.

steps.title: Transfer mixture to tube
steps.instruction: Pipette 50–100 µL of the resulting solution into an Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Acidify, extract, and mix
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 6 N HCl, then add 300 µL of chloroform, vortex the tube, and centrifuge for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Collect and dry chloroform layer
steps.instruction: Withdraw 200 µL of the bottom (chloroform) phase and dry it in a GC vial at 75 °C.

steps.title: Derivatize with TMS
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of trimethylsilyl (TMS) reagent, cover the vial, and heat at 75 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer to GC and run analysis
steps.instruction: Transfer the dried TMS‑derivatized sample to a GC insert, cap it, and analyze on an Agilent 5973N‑MSD coupled to an Agilent 6890 GC equipped with a DB‑17MS column (30 m × 0.25 mm × 0.25 µm) using electron‑impact ionization at 70 eV.

steps.title: Set SIM ion monitoring
steps.instruction: Program selective ion monitoring for: palmitate (m/z 313, IS C17 = 327) and cholesterol (m/z 368, IS cholesterol‑d₇ = 375); consult references for additional lipids.
